newsitem.title: USA: Viacom to post $100 mln pretax Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Viacom to post $100 mln pretax Q4 charge.

text.p: Viacom Inc said on Tuesday that it will report a fourth quarter pretax charge of $100 million from its Blockbuster unit.
Viacom said the charge primarily reflects costs associated with the closing of approximately 50 underperforming Blockbuster Music locations, or about 10 percent of its stores.
Certain costs are also associated with moving Blockbuster's headquarters to Dallas from Fort Lauderdale, Fla., Viacom said.
Viacom spokesman Carl Folta said the company is reporting its fourth quarter results in late February and the company could not give a forecast about its results for the period.
The store closings of the unprofitable stores will be scattered throughout the chain, leaving the company with 450 Blockbuster Music stores by the end of 1997, Folta said.
"It's a difficult environment for the music retailers now," he said.
Viacom had earlier disclosed plans to review the performance of its Blockbuster Music operations after the holiday sales season, the company said.
Blockbuster's previously announced headquarters move offers efficient transportation for product distribution and business travel that will improve the company's efficiency, Viacom said.
